messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

These medicines include combinations with losartan, lisinopril, valsartan, and more.
Triplet: ["combination blood pressure medicines", "include combination with", "valsartan"]

The relation 'include combination with' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject entity is a component of the combination therapy that includes the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'may be prescribed with': The subject drug may be prescribed in combination with the medication specified by the object entity.
B. 'is part of': The subject drug or treatment is a component or element of the larger program or regimen specified by the object entity.
C. 'has related treatment guide': The subject drug is associated with the medical treatment guide specified by the object entity.
D. 'applies to': The subject entity is applicable to the group of patients or conditions specified by the object entity.
E. 'applies to patients who are to be managed with': The subject drug is used for patients who are managed with the procedure or treatment specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.
